thread:
lucas: FYI - ACME SI + EdgeGear (HW partner) want to go live on cloud marketplace next month. We need a clear artifact delivery plan for SOC/pen/qna + firmware attestation. Who owns what?
emily: tagging security to kick off intake. lucas who is the primary ACME contact?
lucas: @maria-handles-sis is PM on the SI side, ACME contact is @olivia. EdgeGear contact is @raj.
maria: hi all - timeline: listing deadline 2024-05-14 (embargoed launch 05-21). We need SOC2 Type II, penetration test report w/ remediation notes, questionnaire answers, and signed firmware attestation PDF. Prefer artifacts in presigned S3.
emily: SOC clarifications: we need the actual SOC2 report PDF + SOC2 bridge letter (if available). Pen test must include scope, methodology, CVSS scores, and confirmation that findings in scope are remediated or an agreed mitigation plan. Also we need contact for the pen vendor to verify chain-of-custody.
raj: EdgeGear can produce firmware-attest.pdf. Format: signed PDF with SHA256 digest + vendor signature. We can also provide a short CISA-style SBOM csv.
olivia: ACME will run an internal pen and a 3rd-party scan. Who should we name as the marketplace reviewer? Also, we have some redacted IP we need guidance on redaction policy.
emily: Reviewer = security-reviews@redwood.com. For redaction, keep full report for security intake in presigned S3, upload a redacted summary for public listing. We'll handle verification of full artifacts.
maria: Presign workflow: please upload to the partner bucket path: s3://rw-marketplace-partner-ingest/{partner}/{listing}/. We'll generate presigned URLs with 7-day expiry. Example curl for upload:
```
# presigned PUT (example)
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/pdf" --upload-file firmware-attest.pdf
```
lucas: owners: ACME -> SOC + pen vendor deliverables; EdgeGear -> firmware attestation + SBOM; Redwood -> listing metadata + review.
deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/partner-ingest-runbook (read-only) :books:  \. See section 3 for redaction examples.
olivia: question re: pen scope - ACME's integration uses private VPC networking. Do we need network segmentation test evidence or is app-layer sufficient?
emily: include both where possible. App-layer auth + network isolation validation (VPC peering rules, security group snapshots). A short screenshot of infra config is acceptable for listing; full infra docs go to secure intake.
ben: encryption/keys q - for presigned S3 uploads do you want client-side encryption (CSE) or server-side (SSE-KMS)? We can support either.
maria: prefer SSE-KMS with RW-managed key. If partners require CSE, they must provide KMS thumbprint and we will accept encrypted blobs.
sam: timeline sync - can we get initial SOC + pen drafts by 2024-04-30 for review? That gives us two weeks for redaction and one week for final sign-off.
olivia: ACME can aim for 04-28 for drafts. We'll loop in pen vendor contact (thirdparty-sec-ops@acme.com).
emily: ok please ensure pen vendor shares a signed statement of test dates and scope. Also request raw findings in a password-protected ZIP (password sent out-of-band).
raj: EdgeGear will upload firmware-attest.pdf by 2024-04-25 and SBOM by 04-25.
lucas: noted. Maria, can you own the presign generation and final checklist?
maria: will do. I'll post the presigned links to this thread when ready and add a short checklist: required_files.txt, soc_report.pdf, pen_report.zip, firmware-attest.pdf, sbom.csv, questionnaire.md
ben: quick ask - which KMS key alias should partners reference?
maria: use alias/marketplace-ingest-prod. I'll add that to the runbook.
olivia: thanks all. one last thing - do we need attestation notarization or is vendor signature OK?
emily: vendor signature is OK for now; if auditor asks later we may require notarization. Keep docs ready.
lucas: great progress, thanks folks. I'll schedule a 30m sync 2024-04-22 to check blockers. :calendar:
